description:
A fast, resilient, multi-source file retriever and download engine


What's Changed
🚀 Features
- Feat export and import settings as a portable .hydata file by @ja7ad in #267
- Feat allow move and rename for stopped incomplete downloads by @ja7ad in #280
- Feat add order by addition and fix last try date sorting by @ja7ad in #282
- Feat plugin support by @ja7ad in #286
- Feat install and update bundled official plugins by @ja7ad in #287
- Feat add shared catalog and update controls by @ja7ad in #290
- Feat add torrent downloader plugin and native components support by @ja7ad in #292
- Feat allow 256 connections and restore windows from macOS Dock by @ja7ad in #298
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fix let a hostless extension connect once the user trusts it by @ja7ad in #270
- Fix build iced from the fork with tiny-skia damage fixes by @ja7ad in #271
- Fix make download filenames portable to Windows by @m4siha in #274
- Fix build AppImage on 20.04 and bundle xkbcommon by @ja7ad in #278
- Fix use IE 11 Trident string as default User-Agent by @ja7ad in #279
- Fix use dark selection background for text inputs in dark theme by @m4siha in #281
- Fix enforce standard minimum size for progress dialog by @sensifai-team in #283
- Fix support platform-specific shortcuts and layout mapping by @ja7ad in #284
- Fix open media dropdown only on click by @m4siha in #289
- Fix create desktop shortcut by default by @ja7ad in #291
- Fix use clang backend for crash plugin in windows by @ja7ad in #295
- Fix YouTube queuing, console flashes and URL loading by @sensifai-team in #296
- Fix disable unsupported startup toggle for portable profiles by @m4siha in #297
- Fix show download percentage in paused status column by @m4siha in #301
- Fix reject HTML block pages posing as binary downloads by @ja7ad in #303
- Fix preserve Windows drive roots in Properties by @m4siha in #304
Full Changelog: v1.0.1...v1.1.0
